rationale: The material prompt requirement is issue diagnosis, safety screen, classification, and actionable report. At # Browser Testing with DevTools, the source is scoped to Tests in real browsers via Chrome DevTools MCP. Use when building or debugging anything that runs in a browser. Use when you need to inspect the DOM, capture console errors, analyze network requests, profile performance, or verify visual output with real runtime data. Requires the chrome-devtools MC; that scope does not provide a plausible route to the required input/output boundary.
